title: Chehlum Apne Bhai Ka
body:
Karti Hai Zainab Karbobala Me Chehlum Apne Bhai Ka
maajaye Ki Turbat Par Ye Nauha Hai Majayi Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
01. Utho Zainab Aai Hai
ujda Kunba Laai Hai
haal Suno Maajayi Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Sunlo Bhaiya Mere Bayn
dil Ko Nahi Hai Mere Chain
nauha Hai Dukhpaayi Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Shaam Ke Zindaan Se Chutke
poora Kiya Hai Zainab Ne
maqsad Apne Bhai Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Sar Se Chini Mere Chaadar
neel Hai Mere Baazu Par
gham Hai Mujhe Ruswaai Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Baali Sakina Ro Ro Kar
margai Zindaan Me Aakar
pursa Lo Shahdaai Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Maa Ki Lahad Par Jaana Hai
saath Mujhe Lejaana Hai
khoon Bhara Kurta Bhai Ka
<<MINI>>
haye Hussaina Haye Hussain
